title: The Bee at the Beach
lines: Meg and her dad went to the beach.
They had a meal of peach and tea.
A bee sat on the last bit of peach.
Meg let the bee have it.
Then she went to sleep in the sun.
She had a dream of a green sea.
Meg got up and ran to the deep sea.

questions.ask: What did Meg and her dad eat?
questions.listenFor: A meal of peach and tea.
A green sea. Ask what she did next.

questions.ask: Was Meg right to give the bee her peach? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for the reason.
